name: Prolog
template:
parent(tom, bob).
parent(bob, ann).
parent(bob, pat).
grandparent(X, Z) :- parent(X, Y), parent(Y, Z).

main :- write('Hello, World!'), nl,
    forall(grandparent(tom, G), (write(G), nl)).

:- initialization(main).

; NASM, Linux x86-64
        global  _start
        section .text
_start: mov     rax, 1          ; write
        mov     rdi, 1          ; stdout
        mov     rsi, msg
        mov     rdx, len
        syscall
        mov     rax, 60         ; exit
        xor     rdi, rdi
        syscall

        section .data
msg:    db      "Hello, World!", 10
len:    equ     $ - msg
